title: Verify fix PR pre-commit check passes and merge to main
description: Once the PR from devops-deployment-metrics-jj7.1 is open, wait for its 'pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest' check to complete and confirm it is green (use 'gh pr checks <PR_NUMBER>'). If green, merge the PR into main (e.g. 'gh pr merge <PR_NUMBER> --squash'). If it fails, report the failure log and stop -- do not merge.
acceptance_criteria: pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest check is SUCCESS on the fix PR; PR merged into main.

title: Push harden-runner fix branch and open PR
description: The branch fix/harden-runner-cdn-allowlist-typo already has commit f8ee559 correcting .github/workflows/tests.yml (production.cloudflare.docker.com -> production.cloudfront.docker.com). Push this branch to origin and open a PR against main referencing GitHub issue #999 and beads epic devops-deployment-metrics-jj7. Commands: 'git push -u origin fix/harden-runner-cdn-allowlist-typo' then 'gh pr create --title "fix: correct harden-runner CDN domain typo in tests.yml" --body "Fixes flexion/devops-deployment-metrics#999" --base main'. Requires explicit user go-ahead before pushing/opening the PR per repo git policy -- confirm with the user first if not already authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Branch pushed to origin; PR opened against main and linked to issue #999.

title: Fix harden-runner egress allowlist typo blocking pre-commit CI check
description: The step-security/harden-runner allowed-endpoints list in .github/workflows/tests.yml contains 'production.cloudflare.docker.com:443' but Docker Hub's real image-layer CDN redirect is 'production.cloudfront.docker.com:443'. This blocks docker pull of rhysd/actionlint (used by the pre-commit hook), which fails the required 'pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest' branch-protection check on every PR. Currently blocking 9 open dependency-update PRs (#978, #980, #982-986, #988, #989) plus indirectly PR #870.
design: Single-line domain fix in .github/workflows/tests.yml. Root cause confirmed via CI job logs (docker pull DNS lookup denied by harden-runner egress policy) and branch protection required_status_checks config.
acceptance_criteria: allowed-endpoints in tests.yml corrected to production.cloudfront.docker.com:443; pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest check passes on a PR touching this file; previously-blocked dependency PRs re-run green.

title: Update PR #870 branch and verify pre-commit check goes green
description: PR #870 was previously blocked by the harden-runner CDN allowlist typo (docker pull of rhysd/actionlint denied by egress policy), which is now fixed on main. Update PR #870's branch onto the latest main with 'gh pr update-branch 870', wait for CI to complete, then check the 'pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest' status with 'gh pr checks 870'. Report whether it is now SUCCESS. If it still fails, paste the failure log and stop -- do not investigate further, just report.
acceptance_criteria: 'pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest' check on PR #870 reports SUCCESS after the branch update.
